question: Which materials are listed as suitable for ritual vessels?
premises: Vessels may be made of clay
Vessels may be tortoise-born or made of bell metal
Vessels may be made of copper or metal
inference: Ritual vessels can be fashioned from clay, tortoise-derived material, bell metal, or copper
uncertainties: The exact meaning of kūrmajaṃ as a vessel material is uncertain
plain_english: O Goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell metal, or born of copper and metal.
